verdict.rationale: Gitea's documentation recommends migrating repositories into Gitea, and a hands-on user reports migrating the TiDB repo to a Gitea instance. So bringing a repository in from elsewhere is evidenced, though another user found migrating existing repos 'surprisingly difficult.' Nothing in the pack shows that issues, pull requests, reviews, or comments come across with the repository. missing for 10: documented import of issues, pull requests, reviews and comments, named source platforms (e.g. GitHub/GitLab) beyond Gogs, and in-depth migration docs.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can import repositories from another hosting platform along with their issues, pull requests, reviews, and comments

citations.quote: The recommended method is to migrate repositories from Gogs to Gitea.
Migrated the TiDB repo to the 'Try Gitea' service.
